richiami.difetto: Engine speed may exceed the permitted rpm and cause the automatic gearbox to shift to neutral.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a control box which at 5500 rpm will switch the engine fuelling system back to petrol ensuring that the engine maximum speed is under the control of the O/E rev limiter.
richiami.titolo: GAS CONVERSION MAY NEUTRALISE ENGINE REV LIMITER
